verdict.rationale: The only AI-related evidence is that Azure Copilot, an in-product AI assistant, can generate Terraform configurations (azure-docs-19). That is AI-generated output inside Azure, but nothing shows it analyzing the user's own data to produce insights or suggestions. The Cost Management APIs (azure-docs-30) support multidimensional analysis, but through user-built filters rather than AI. Missing for 10: evidence of AI-generated insights drawn from the user's data (cost, usage, telemetry), proactive AI recommendations, documentation of Copilot's data-analysis scope, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
